knobs.note: BH-4971: the repo whose Harness CI (harness-ci.yml) merge-queue batch runs are recorded, one worker ci_batches row per run. Only cromford runs that workflow. NOT settable from the control plane: it is an identity the lane reads GitHub as, so only env/global.env on the box moves it.

BH-4971: at most this many unrecorded batch runs are read and recorded per tick (two GitHub reads each in practice: the jobs of every attempt and the plan job's annotations; a run with over 100 jobs pages up to CI_BATCH_LEDGER_PAGES). The rest are logged as deferred and drain oldest first on later ticks.

BH-4971: the window. Runs created in the last this-many days are candidates, and the ledger GET over the same window is the skip-set. A run older than the window that was never recorded is not backfilled.

BH-4971: at most this many 100-run pages of the harness-ci.yml run list per tick. When every page is full the log says the window was not fully read. Also the page cap on one run's jobs list. Per-tick GitHub reads: this + 2 x CI_BATCH_LEDGER_MAX in practice, at most this + (this + 1) x CI_BATCH_LEDGER_MAX.
